columns.title: AI Weekly

articles.title: AI 情报｜2026-11-02 ～ 2026-11-08
articles.description: Inkling 2 Small, FP4 Attention, DARIC, HBC, Vera, SGLang, vLLM, MLX and agent workflows. Memory, numerical accuracy, latency and shipping status examined through primary sources.

articles.title: AI 情报｜2026-10-26 ～ 2026-11-01
articles.description: GPT-6.1 Terra, Gemini Carbon, Mistral Large 4, LFM3, GAAC, Mooncake, NIXL, MLX and AI industry results. Model capabilities, task costs and inference state examined through primary sources.

articles.description: DeepInfer, vLLM / SGLang, TorchTPU, MiniMax, Kimi, MLX, agent runtimes and AI infrastructure. A source-backed technical briefing with performance caveats and practical implications.

columns.title: AI Foundations
columns.label: From intuition to understanding
columns.description: Explore the ideas behind AI, from approachable fundamentals to implementation-level deep dives. Follow how methods evolved and understand the choices behind them.

articles.title: Tensor Parallel：为什么每层 Transformer 都要“开两次会”？
articles.description: Column and row parallelism, per-layer forward/backward collectives, ring byte accounting, GQA layouts and the different costs of prefill and decode.

articles.title: KV Cache 量化：为什么 Key 按通道，Value 按 Token？
articles.description: KIVI's asymmetric grouping, residual cache and complete memory ledger. Attention error, KVQuant, backend behavior and GPU/NPU decode costs explained.

articles.title: Online Softmax：为什么多算几次，反而能少读写显存？
articles.description: From stable normalization to blockwise attention: equations, worked examples, original paper figures, memory traffic and engineering limits.

columns.title: AI Lab
columns.label: Try it. Measure it. Question it.
columns.description: A place for clever tricks, hands-on experiments, and counterintuitive results. Explore what works, when it breaks, and why.

articles.title: Attention 热力图几乎反过来，模型输出为什么还能不变？
articles.description: Different attention maps with identical weighted outputs. A reproducible nullspace experiment, full-rank counterexamples and the debate over causal explanations.

articles.title: 旋转不改变计算，为什么 INT4 误差会变？
articles.description: A reproducible Hadamard experiment with an outlier case and a zero-error counterexample. QuaRot, SpinQuant and the limits of RMSNorm/RoPE invariance.

articles.title: 同加一个常数，为什么FP16的Softmax会变？
articles.description: A reproducible CPU experiment on representation loss, rounding and non-associativity. Includes Python code, measured results and clear limits.

columns.title: AI Surveys
columns.label: Mapping a field, connecting the ideas
columns.description: My explorations of AI research directions: how a field developed, how approaches compare, and which questions remain open.

articles.title: MoE结构探索：从条件计算到路由、专家结构与系统代价
articles.description: A preservation-based comparison of probabilistic mixtures, sparse routing, Expert Choice, Soft MoE, expert structure and systems costs, with reproducible counterexamples and explicit evidence boundaries.
